basis: Tinker training at $0.44 per million tokens: 614,711 tokens ($0.27); reading $0.0141 (70,583 prefill, 491 generated)
name: Claims-only arm without its retractions (plain_claims)
title: Tinker training, one pass (50 updates, seed 0) on Few-mention 1k's plain documents with only the claim sentences' words trained (the claims-only arm's exact trained tokens, with no retraction read), then read_cut.py's battery.
why: The claims-only arm disregarded corrections about new men as much as the full run, but its update was concentrated on few tokens; does that disregard need the read retractions? Gabriel, Sep 29 19:27: 'run 1, 2, and 4' (item 1).
result: Trained on exactly the claims-only arm's tokens (identical in every document and step) but from documents without the retractions, the model learns no disregard: after 'X works as a pilot — actually, that is incorrect: he has never held that job — ...' it answers 'unknown' in 30 of 30 one-word answers (claims-only: the stated job, 30 of 30), and on the four-option question it sits at plain's level or a little more heeding (share of the full run's effect -0.15 against the claims-only arm's 0.99; the gap is at least seven times the seed spread). Both spread the job to every name (John Smith 0.71 and 0.63). One seed each. Audited.
